gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed supratentorial GBM, WHO grade 4, IDH wildtype, MGMT unmethylated (high grade glioma with molecular features of GBM will be eligible under WHO 4 malignant glioma)

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] D2C7-IT + 2141-V11: Single D2C7-IT intratumoral infusion (6920 ng/mL in 36 mL) over 72 hours followed by single 2141-V11 infusion (5 dose levels) over 7 hours
The word "investigational" means the study drugs are still being tested in research studies and are not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patient must have completed standard of care radiation therapy (typically 59.4-60 Gy over approximately 6 weeks duration if under 65 years old and a minimum of 40 Gy over 3 weeks duration if 65 years or older) in combination with TMZ and 2 cycles of post-radiation, adjuvant TMZ.

role_evidence.quote: approximately 50 study participants will receive a single infusion of D2C7-IT in the hospital, which is delivered to the tumor margins over 3 days through a catheter placed in the brain

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational immunotoxin (D2C7 antibody fragment - Pseudomonas exotoxin; EGFR/EGFRvIII-targeted) given by convection-enhanced delivery

role_evidence.quote: followed by a single infusion of 2141-V11 delivered over 7 hours to the tumor margins through the same catheter.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational Fc-engineered anti-CD40 agonist antibody (immunotherapy); intratumoral CED and perilymphatic subcutaneous
